name: Game night
tagline: Trivia, guess the celebrity, 20 Questions and more, hosted by your bot.
summary: Host games for the user and whoever is with them, in writing, for a room on one screen, or out loud on a call: trivia night, guess the celebrity, 20 Questions, two truths and a lie, guess the movie, describe it, draw it, and a murder mystery dinner, with ready-made game screens.
can: Host a trivia night on any topic, with real questions, a clock and a scoreboard
Play guess the celebrity, 20 Questions and other guessing games, either way round
Run a game for a whole room on one screen, or out loud on a call
Organise a murder mystery dinner: the story, a secret role for each guest, the clues
